map.永宣青花用进口\"苏麻离青\"，发色浓艳带铁锈斑、晕散；康熙青花用国产浙料，发色: Ming Yongxi blue-and-white uses imported "Sumali blue", with a rich color bearing iron-rust spots and bleeding; Kangxi blue-and-white uses domestic Zhejiang material, with an emerald-blue color in layers (the so-called "blue-and-white five colors"). For reign marks, the Ming writes "Da Ming Xuande nian zhi" and the Qing writes "Da Qing Kangxi nian zhi"; the fonts and layouts each have period characteristics, and the combination of the two allows fairly reliable dating.

Reign marks must be studied together with body, glaze, shape and ornament; a single piece of evidence does not hold.
map.宋瓷与明清华丽彩瓷在鉴定思路上有何不同？: How does the identification approach differ between Song porcelain and the ornate Ming / Qing wares?
map.宋瓷重釉色与单色美学（汝之天青、钧之窑变、定之白），多以釉质、开片、支烧痕断代；: Song porcelain emphasizes glaze color and monochrome aesthetics (Ru sky-blue, Jun kiln transmutation, Ding white), and is usually dated by glaze quality, crackling and spur marks; Ming and Qing emphasize polychrome painting and elaborate shapes (blue-and-white, doucai, fencai), relying more on the period characteristics of cobalt, enamel materials, reign marks and ornament subjects.
